2.07pm And that brings about an anti-climactic end to the Sri Lankan innings! In the end 
Afghanistan will need 269 to win, though Sri Lanka would have undoubtedly wanted 
more heading into the final over. Charith Asalanka, whose 95-ball 91 had anchored the 
Lankan effort, was run out off the first ball of the final over meaning they could get only 
five off it. On the whole though, Sri Lanka will be fairly pleased to have even got that 
much after the Afghan seamers had troubled them early on, and then the spinners had 
looked to throttle the middle overs. It took a 99-run fifth wicket stand between Asalanka 
and Dhananjaya de Silva (51) to rescue Sri Lanka from 84 for 4, with Asalanka stringing 
together stands with Dasun Shanaka and Dushan Hemantha to push the total along. For 
the visitors, each of the six bowlers used picked up at least a wicket, though Mujeeb Ur 
Rahman was the only one that was bowled out. The fact that Azmatullah Omarzai in 
particular, who picked up 1 for 35, only bowled eight overs might been seen as a 
misstep. Join Shashwat for the start of the chase in about 30 minutes or so.
